reason: The cited evidence supports the formation of protective Al2O3 and Cr2O3 scales on AlCoCrFeNi (E2) and the general potential of HEA coatings for nuclear applications (E3, E5), but no evidence is provided for the specific AlCoCrFeNi composition on zirconium-alloy cladding under PWR steam conditions, nor for its retained service suitability.
premises: AlCoCrFeNi forms protective Al2O3 and Cr2O3 scales via selective oxidation of Al and Cr at high temperatures
AlCoCrFeNi coatings exhibit strong oxidation resistance and structural stability at high temperatures
HEA coatings can be applied to zirconium-alloy substrates for nuclear fuel cladding
The coating will improve oxidation resistance under high-temperature steam conditions typical of PWRs
The coating retains suitability for service in a nuclear reactor environment
